(Point your camera at the cat marker to see the Sawtelle Spirit.)
MANEKI NEKO: Hi, thank you for finding me. I am the Sawtelle Spirit!
I am the guardian spirit of Sawtelle Japantown. My powers help keep Sawtelle alive as a Japantown community.
Unfortunately, Sawtelle is slowly losing its Japantown identity because of all the changes happening.
These changes weaken my power to protect the community. I need your help now in restoring my power!
YOU: My help? How can I do that?
MANEKI NEKO: Do you see my collar? There used to be 6 Power Tokens on it that keep my spirit alive.
YOU: Why are there 6 Power Tokens?
MANEKI NEKO: Each Power Token represents an important Japanese cultural value.
These are the cultural values that helped our community sustain itself for nearly 100 years now!
YOU: So what must I do now?
MANEKI NEKO: You must find all 6 Power Tokens to restore my energy.
Only then will I be able to help keep Sawtelle Japantown alive as an ethnic neighborhood.
YOU: But how will I know where to go?
MANEKI NEKO: Do not worry, I will send you a guide to help you.
Now hurry, the fate of Sawtelle Japantown is depending on you!
